edges: Maud is to stay with Uncle Silas until she comes of age.

multi_hop_neighbors.edge: Dudley is the son of Silas Ruthyn.
Dudley accidentally murders Madame de la Rougierre.
Dudley is thought to be hiding in Australia.
Silas frightens Maud but is seemingly kind to her.

edges: Maud Ruthyn is the daughter of Austin Ruthyn.
Maud Ruthyn learns about her family from her cousin Lady Monica Knollys.
Madame de la Rougierre is hired as a governess for Maud Ruthyn.
Austin Ruthyn asks Maud if she is willing to undergo an ordeal to clear her uncle's name.
Dudley attempts to court Maud Ruthyn.
Maud discovers Madame de la Rougierre burgling her father's desk.
Maud confronts Silas about Dudley's marriage proposition.
Maud Ruthyn is happily married to Lord Ilbury.
